subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should #38327 remain the canonical tracker until both the sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios paths are proven fixed, or should the auth-stack dependency path be split into a separate canonical issue now?
rationale: The open sanitizer PR covers one concrete slice, while the remaining dependency/auth-stack slice touches provider auth and dependency policy where automation should not choose the long-term tracking and closure boundary alone.

options.title: Keep #38327 canonical until both slices resolve
options.body: Review and prove the sanitizer PR first, then keep this issue open for native Vertex ADC/gaxios proof or a focused follow-up.

options.title: Split the auth-stack path now
options.body: Move the gaxios/node-fetch/domexception ADC failure into a focused canonical issue and close #38327 only after the sanitizer slice is merged and verified.

options.title: Accept sanitizer-only closure with explicit override
options.body: A provider owner may decide the sanitizer slice is enough for this issue, but should preserve the ADC reproduction in a durable follow-up before closure.

recommendation.title: Keep #38327 canonical until both slices resolve
recommendation.body: Review and prove the sanitizer PR first, then keep this issue open for native Vertex ADC/gaxios proof or a focused follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses SDK helper ownership, provider auth behavior, dependency policy, and canonical issue triage.
